{{Quote|Luke, in case Sekot hasn't noticed, the Yuuzhan Vong armada is so close we can practically touch it. They also have battle groups orbiting Muscave, Stentat, Improcco, and The Covey.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>}}
'''Improcco''' was an [[Water/Legends|icy]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]]. It was the ninth planet from the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Coruscant Prime/Legends|Coruscant Prime]]. Improcco had one [[Moon/Legends|moon]],<ref name="CatCW" /> known as the [[Frozen Moon of Improcco]].<ref name="HtSW">''[[How to Speak Wookiee]]''</ref>
